item.description: A child for the Argyreoi: Astos Timides ~2719, born to Timion #1425 and Kallope #2802. It will grow old; its parents will not.

item.title: Agathgenes #2483 was broken in the archipelago (plague). The bones lie scattered in Asphod
item.description: Agathgenes #2483 was broken in the archipelago (plague). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel and will knit again; only fire unmakes the Sown.
